tasks.subject: Task 0: Checkov IaC policy baseline
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Documented, version-controlled IaC security standard (Checkov check-ID allowlist) prod is held to with zero tolerance.

**Files:** Create security/iac-policy.md, security/checkov-baseline.txt

**Acceptance Criteria:** iac-policy.md documents in/out-of-scope checks + rationale; baseline.txt drives CI; checkov --check runs only baseline.

**Verify:** cd infrastructure && cdk synth >/dev/null && checkov -d cdk.out --framework cloudformation --check $(paste -sd, ../security/checkov-baseline.txt) --compact

```json:metadata
{"files": ["security/iac-policy.md", "security/checkov-baseline.txt"], "verifyCommand": "cd infrastructure && cdk synth >/dev/null && checkov -d cdk.out --framework cloudformation --check $(paste -sd, ../security/checkov-baseline.txt) --compact", "acceptanceCriteria": ["policy documented", "baseline.txt drives CI", "checkov runs only baseline"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Minimize Lambda base-image CVE surface
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace public.ecr.aws/lambda/python:3.12 so trivy image passes under zero-tolerance.

**Files:** Modify Dockerfile

**Acceptance Criteria:** arm64 build + handler loads via awslambdaric; trivy image all-severity = 0 (or only accepted no-fix); FAISS imports.

**Verify:** docker build --platform linux/arm64 -t lookout-test . && trivy image --exit-code 1 --severity UNKNOWN,LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL lookout-test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Dockerfile"], "verifyCommand": "docker build --platform linux/arm64 -t lookout-test . && trivy image --exit-code 1 --severity UNKNOWN,LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL lookout-test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["arm64 build + handler", "trivy 0 findings", "FAISS imports"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Per-account OIDC deploy roles (exact-match env-scoped trust)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Two least-privilege OIDC roles with StringEquals trust; LookoutDevOidc/LookoutProdOidc in app.py.

**Files:** Modify infrastructure/stacks/github_oidc_stack.py, infrastructure/app.py; Test evals/test_oidc_stack.py

**Acceptance Criteria:** dev StringEquals ref sub; prod StringEquals environment:production sub; AssumeRole on exactly 4 cdk-hnb659fds-* ARNs; synth ok; pytest asserts no StringLike.

**Verify:** cd infrastructure && cdk synth LookoutDevOidc LookoutProdOidc >/dev/null && cd .. && PYTHONPATH="$PWD:$PWD/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages" $(uv python find 3.12) -m pytest evals/test_oidc_stack.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["infrastructure/stacks/github_oidc_stack.py", "infrastructure/app.py", "evals/test_oidc_stack.py"], "verifyCommand": "cd infrastructure && cdk synth LookoutDevOidc LookoutProdOidc >/dev/null", "acceptanceCriteria": ["dev ref sub StringEquals", "prod env sub StringEquals", "4-ARN AssumeRole", "no StringLike"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: CDK resource tagging (Project/Environment/ManagedBy)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Every CDK resource tagged Project/Environment/ManagedBy.

**Files:** Modify infrastructure/app.py; Test evals/test_tagging.py

**Acceptance Criteria:** dev Environment=dev, prod Environment=prod, Project=Lookout + ManagedBy=cdk app-wide.

**Verify:** PYTHONPATH="$PWD:$PWD/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages" $(uv python find 3.12) -m pytest evals/test_tagging.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["infrastructure/app.py", "evals/test_tagging.py"], "verifyCommand": "PYTHONPATH=\"$PWD:$PWD/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages\" $(uv python find 3.12) -m pytest evals/test_tagging.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["dev=dev", "prod=prod", "Project+ManagedBy"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: ci.yml — quality + zero-tolerance security suite + no-open-PR gate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Validation workflow; warn dev / block PR-to-main; expose workflow_call (Task 8 reuses).

**Files:** Create .github/workflows/ci.yml

**Acceptance Criteria:** quality + security + no-open-prs jobs; STRICT=base_ref==main toggles hard/soft fail; on: push[dev] + pull_request[dev,main] + workflow_call; actionlint clean.

**Verify:** actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/ci.yml"], "verifyCommand": "actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml", "acceptanceCriteria": ["3 jobs", "warn dev / block main", "workflow_call", "actionlint clean"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: deploy-dev.yml — auto-deploy dev on push
tasks.description:
**Goal:** On push to dev after CI success, assume dev role, cdk deploy dev stacks.

**Files:** Create .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml

**Acceptance Criteria:** workflow_run on ci success/branch dev; OIDC AWS_DEV_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN; cdk deploy LookoutDev LookoutDevMonitoring; concurrency deploy-dev; actionlint clean.

**Verify:** actionlint .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml"], "verifyCommand": "actionlint .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml", "acceptanceCriteria": ["workflow_run after ci", "dev role OIDC", "deploys dev+monitoring", "concurrency"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: deploy-prod.yml — environment-gated prod deploy
tasks.description:

**Acceptance Criteria:** push[main]; strict-gate uses ./.github/workflows/ci.yml; deploy job environment: production; OIDC AWS_PROD_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN; cdk deploy LookoutProd LookoutProdMonitoring; concurrency deploy-prod; actionlint clean.

**Verify:** actionlint .github/workflows/deploy-prod.yml

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/deploy-prod.yml"], "verifyCommand": "actionlint .github/workflows/deploy-prod.yml", "acceptanceCriteria": ["reusable strict gate", "environment: production pause", "prod role", "deploys prod+monitoring"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 10: End-to-end verification
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the pipeline behaves per acceptance criteria on the real repo.

**Files:** none

**Acceptance Criteria:** dev push auto-deploys; vuln PR blocked; second PR triggers no-open-prs block; direct push to main rejected; clean merge -> production approval gate -> prod deploys; prod role un-assumable outside env.

**Verify:** observe Actions runs; prod job aws sts get-caller-identity = prod account.

```json:metadata
{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "gh run list --repo drupell/lookout --limit 10", "acceptanceCriteria": ["dev auto-deploy", "vuln PR blocked", "no-open-prs blocks", "main direct push rejected", "prod env gate", "prod role isolated"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
